title: Vantage · Robot Arm Suite
subtitle: 6-DOF arm simulation & control
description: One safety-gated motion pipeline for a 6-DOF industrial arm, driven six ways: joystick, keyboard, Whisper voice, autonomous PIN entry, an LLM agent and webcam hand gestures.

title: CoDoctor
subtitle: Bangla clinical co-pilot
description: Two phones listen to a Bangla consultation and fuse one transcript; a LangGraph agent team cites clinical guidelines while deterministic rule engines, never the LLM, catch danger signs and drug interactions.

title: Ghostline
subtitle: Low-poly hover racer
description: Race your own best lap: a deterministic, hash-verified physics sim replays ghosts from input logs, so any lap can be shared as a URL. Procedural GLSL sky and track shaders, 35 tests over the sim core.

title: Logarithm Warehouse
subtitle: Resilient microservices platform
description: A fragile e-commerce monolith rebuilt as Order and Inventory services with Redis-backed deterministic chaos testing across scaled replicas, Nginx load balancing, Prometheus/Grafana and CI/CD to Azure.

title: Vernissage
subtitle: Multiplayer 3D art exhibitions
description: Curate your own exhibition from 8,000+ public-domain works from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, then walk through it in 3D with friends: a Go API and WebSocket hub behind a Next.js front end.

title: Swarmlight
subtitle: Canvas survivors-like
description: 1,500 enemies at 60 fps on a single canvas with zero dependencies: spatial hashing, a boot-time sprite atlas and pooled typed arrays so the garbage collector never drops a frame.

title: VisionBridge
subtitle: AI audio descriptions for blind learners
description: Watches YouTube tutorials alongside blind and low-vision learners, decides when the screen actually matters, and speaks a short Gemma-written description in the narrator's natural pauses.

title: TakaFlow
subtitle: Money movement platform
description: A digital wallet to send, request, split and schedule money on a double-entry ledger that always adds up: idempotent transfers, three API replicas behind Nginx, PgBouncer and a monthly-partitioned Postgres.

title: ShopCircuit
subtitle: E-commerce storefront
description: A full storefront with cart, checkout, wishlist and order tracking, plus an admin panel for catalogue and content, on React and Firebase with a Node/Express payment backend.
